title: Spatial-Omni: Spatial Audio Understanding Integration in Multimodal LLMs via FOA Encoding
abstract: arXiv:2606.10738v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Recent multimodal large language models mainly process audio as monaural signals, thereby discarding the spatial cues contained in spatial audio for sound localization, spatial relation reasoning, and spatial scene understanding. We propose Spatial-Omni, a lightweight method that implements SO-Encoder to inject First-Order Ambisonics (FOA) spatial audio into existing Omni LLMs as an independent modality, without modifying their original audio encoders. SO-Encoder provides spatial tokens with limited additional context cost and improves spatial audio understanding through efficient staged training. To support training and evaluation, we construct SO-Dataset, SO-QA, and SO-Bench from open-source data, real recordings, and simulations, containing 400K FOA spatial audio clips and 2.1M spatial question answering pairs. translated_title: Spatial-Omni：通过FOA编码在多模态大语言模型中集成空间音频理解
translated_abstract: 近年来，多模态大语言模型主要以单声道信号的方式处理音频，从而丢弃了空间音频中包含的用于声音定位、空间关系推理和空间场景理解的空间线索。我们提出Spatial-Omni，这是一种轻量级方法，通过实现SO-Encoder，将一阶高保真立体声（FOA）空间音频作为独立模态注入现有的全模态大语言模型中，而无需修改其原始音频编码器。SO-Encoder以有限的额外上下文开销提供空间标记，并通过高效的分阶段训练提升空间音频理解能力。为支持训练和评估，我们基于开源数据、真实录音和模拟数据构建了SO-Dataset、SO-QA和SO-Bench，包含40万个FOA空间音频片段和210万个空间问答对。SO-Bench涵盖16个空间音频理解子任务，包括基础检测和位置估计、空间……
tldr: Spatial-Omni提出了一种轻量级的SO-Encoder方法，将FOA空间音频作为独立模态注入现有全模态大语言模型而无需修改其原始音频编码器，并构建了包含40万个空间音频片段和210万个问答对的数据集与基准，显著提升了模型的空间音频理解能力。
en_tdlr: Spatial-Omni introduces a lightweight SO-Encoder that injects FOA spatial audio into existing Omni LLMs as an independent modality without modifying their original audio encoders, supported by new datasets and benchmarks with 400K spatial audio clips and 2.1M QA pairs for enhanced spatial audio understanding.
